fullText.simplified:
他来了

    第二天，曹操带着军队，向徐州去了。
    徐州城里，几个月以前，刘备听说了元少和曹操在官渡的事，就知道事情会变坏。元少的人多，曹操的人少，打曹操应该要快，越快越好。“等”不是办法，“等”只会让机会没了，好事变坏事。
    刘备知道曹操还是会来打徐州，他不知道曹操会从哪儿来，就让张飞和关羽带着一些人，去徐州城外面的两个小城里看着。这样，如果曹操从那两个小城过来，他们就可以很快知道。
    刘备也从八月等到了十二月，时间太久，有时候他会忘了自己在等谁。突然，就在今天，曹操来了！他带着二十万军队来了！
    这么多军队突然来了，关羽和张飞一点儿都不知道，曹操来得太快了！刘备没有办法，马上给元少写信，请元少来帮自己。元少的军队多，如果元少马上来，曹操就不敢打徐州。
    元少看到信，也吃惊极了，他不知道曹操是什么时候离开官渡的。他想，这是个好机会，这个时候打官渡，曹操一定回不来，自己可以很快拿下官渡。他刚想找助手开会，一个下人进来了。
    下人着急地说：“元大人，不好了，您的小儿子又病了。”
    元少的小儿子是他最喜欢的孩子。这个孩子的身体不太好，很容易生病。每次他生病，元少都非常担心，什么事都不想做。现在听说小儿子又生病了，元少马上把信放在桌子上，看小儿子去了。
    几天以后，元少的助手们听说了徐州的事，对他说：“大人，我们要快去帮刘备，也可以现在打官渡。如果打败了曹操，半个国家就都是我们的了。”
    但是这个时候的元少累极了，他现在什么都不想想。他说：“我孩子的病还没好。现在我不想听这些事，再等等吧！”
fullText.traditional:
他來了

    第二天，曹操帶著軍隊，向徐州去了。
    徐州城裡，幾個月以前，劉備聽說了元少和曹操在官渡的事，就知道事情會變壞。元少的人多，曹操的人少，打曹操應該要快，越快越好。“等”不是辦法，“等”只會讓機會沒了，好事變壞事。
    劉備知道曹操還是會來打徐州，他不知道曹操會從哪兒來，就讓張飛和關羽帶著一些人，去徐州城外面的兩個小城裡看著。這樣，如果曹操從那兩個小城過來，他們就可以很快知道。
    劉備也從八月等到了十二月，時間太久，有時候他會忘了自己在等誰。突然，就在今天，曹操來了！他帶著二十萬軍隊來了！
    這麼多軍隊突然來了，關羽和張飛一點兒都不知道，曹操來得太快了！劉備沒有辦法，馬上給元少寫信，請元少來幫自己。元少的軍隊多，如果元少馬上來，曹操就不敢打徐州。
    元少看到信，也吃驚極了，他不知道曹操是什麼時候離開官渡的。他想，這是個好機會，這個時候打官渡，曹操一定回不來，自己可以很快拿下官渡。他剛想找助手開會，一個下人進來了。
    下人著急地說：“元大人，不好了，您的小兒子又病了。”
    元少的小兒子是他最喜歡的孩子。這個孩子的身體不太好，很容易生病。每次他生病，元少都非常擔心，什麼事都不想做。現在聽說小兒子又生病了，元少馬上把信放在桌子上，看小兒子去了。
    幾天以後，元少的助手們聽說了徐州的事，對他說：“大人，我們要快去幫劉備，也可以現在打官渡。如果打敗了曹操，半個國家就都是我們的了。”
    但是這個時候的元少累極了，他現在什麼都不想想。他說：“我孩子的病還沒好。現在我不想聽這些事，再等等吧！”

sentences.simplified: 元少的人多，曹操的人少，打曹操应该要快，越快越好。
sentences.traditional: 元少的人多，曹操的人少，打曹操應該要快，越快越好。

sentences.english: Yuan Shao has many men, and Cao Cao has few men, so he should fight Cao Cao soon; the sooner, the better.

sentences.simplified: “等”不是办法，“等”只会让机会没了，好事变坏事。
sentences.traditional: “等”不是辦法，“等”只會讓機會沒了，好事變壞事。

sentences.english: “Waiting” is not an option. “Waiting” will only make opportunities disappear and make good things become bad things.

sentences.simplified: 刘备知道曹操还是会来打徐州，他不知道曹操会从哪儿来，
sentences.traditional: 劉備知道曹操還是會來打徐州，他不知道曹操會從哪兒來，

sentences.english: Liu Bei knew that Cao Cao would still come to fight Xuzhou. He didn’t know where Cao Cao would come from, ..

sentences.simplified: 就让张飞和关羽带着一些人，去徐州城外面的两个小城里看着。
sentences.traditional: 就讓張飛和關羽帶著一些人，去徐州城外面的兩個小城裡看著。
sentences.pinyin: jiù ràng zhāng fēi hé guān yǔ dài zhe yì xiē rén qù xú zhōu chéng wài miàn de liǎng ge xiǎo chéng lǐ kān zhe
sentences.english: .. so he had Zhang Fei and Guan Yu take some men to two small cities outside Xuzhou to watch.

sentences.simplified: 这样，如果曹操从那两个小城过来，他们就可以很快知道。
sentences.traditional: 這樣，如果曹操從那兩個小城過來，他們就可以很快知道。

sentences.english: That way, if Cao Cao came from those two small cities, they would know quickly.

sentences.simplified: 刘备也从八月等到了十二月，时间太久，有时候他会忘了自己在等谁。
sentences.traditional: 劉備也從八月等到了十二月，時間太久，有時候他會忘了自己在等誰。
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi yě cóng bā yuè děng dào le shí èr yuè shí jiān tài jiǔ yǒu shí hou tā huì wàng le zì jǐ zài děng shéi
sentences.english: Liu Bei also waited from August to December. It was a long time, and sometimes he would forget who he was waiting for.

sentences.simplified: 突然，就在今天，曹操来了！他带着二十万军队来了！
sentences.traditional: 突然，就在今天，曹操來了！他帶著二十萬軍隊來了！
sentences.pinyin: tū rán jiù zài jīn tiān cáo cāo lái le tā dài zhe èr shí wàn jūn duì lái le
sentences.english: Suddenly, this was the day. Cao Cao had arrived! He arrived with 200,000 troops!

sentences.simplified: 这么多军队突然来了，关羽和张飞一点儿都不知道，曹操来得太快了！
sentences.traditional: 這麼多軍隊突然來了，關羽和張飛一點兒都不知道，曹操來得太快了！
sentences.pinyin: zhè me duō jūn duì tū rán lái le guān yǔ hé zhāng fēi yì diǎn'r dōu bù zhī dào cáo cāo lái de tài kuài le
sentences.english: So many troops suddenly came. Guan Yu and Zhang Fei didn’t know anything. Cao Cao had come too quickly!

sentences.simplified: 刘备没有办法，马上给元少写信，请元少来帮自己。
sentences.traditional: 劉備沒有辦法，馬上給元少寫信，請元少來幫自己。
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi méi yǒu bàn fǎ mǎ shàng gěi yuán shào xiě xìn qǐng yuán shào lái bāng zì jǐ
sentences.english: Liu Bei had no choice but to immediately write to Yuan Shao and ask Yuan Shao to come and help him.

sentences.simplified: 元少的军队多，如果元少马上来，曹操就不敢打徐州。
sentences.traditional: 元少的軍隊多，如果元少馬上來，曹操就不敢打徐州。
sentences.pinyin: yuán shào de jūn duì duō rú guǒ yuán shào mǎ shàng lái cáo cāo jiù bù gǎn dǎ xú zhōu
sentences.english: Yuan Shao had many troops. If Yuan Shao came immediately, Cao Cao would not dare to fight Xuzhou.

sentences.simplified: 元少看到信，也吃惊极了，他不知道曹操是什么时候离开官渡的。
sentences.traditional: 元少看到信，也吃驚極了，他不知道曹操是什麼時候離開官渡的。
sentences.pinyin: yuán shào kàn dào xìn yě chī jīng jí le tā bù zhī dào cáo cāo shì shén me shí hou lí kāi guān dù de
sentences.english: Yuan Shao was also surprised when he saw the letter. He didn’t know when Cao Cao had left Guandu.

sentences.simplified: 他想，这是个好机会，
sentences.traditional: 他想，這是個好機會，
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng zhè shì ge hǎo jī huì
sentences.english: He thought this was a good opportunity.

sentences.simplified: 这个时候打官渡，曹操一定回不来，自己可以很快拿下官渡。
sentences.traditional: 這個時候打官渡，曹操一定回不來，自己可以很快拿下官渡。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge shí hou dǎ guān dù cáo cāo yí dìng huí bù lái zì jǐ kě yǐ hěn kuài ná xià guān dù
sentences.english: If I fight Guandu now, Cao Cao will not be able to return, and I can quickly take Guandu.

sentences.simplified: 他刚想找助手开会，一个下人进来了。
sentences.traditional: 他剛想找助手開會，一個下人進來了。
sentences.pinyin: tā gāng xiǎng zhǎo zhù shǒu kāi huì yí ge xià rén jìn lái le
sentences.english: He was about to have a meeting with his assistants when a servant came in.

sentences.simplified: 下人着急地说：“元大人，不好了，您的小儿子又病了。”
sentences.traditional: 下人著急地說：“元大人，不好了，您的小兒子又病了。”
sentences.pinyin: xià rén zháo jí de shuō yuán dà ren bù hǎo le nín de xiǎo ér zi yòu bìng le
sentences.english: The servant said anxiously, “Lord Yuan. Something bad has happened. Your youngest son is sick again.”

sentences.simplified: 元少的小儿子是他最喜欢的孩子。这个孩子的身体不太好，很容易生病。
sentences.traditional: 元少的小兒子是他最喜歡的孩子。這個孩子的身體不太好，很容易生病。
sentences.pinyin: yuán shào de xiǎo ér zi shì tā zuì xǐ huan de hái zi zhè ge hái zi de shēn tǐ bú tài hǎo hěn róng yì shēng bìng
sentences.english: Yuan Shao’s youngest son was his favorite child. The child was in poor health, and he got sick easily.

sentences.simplified: 每次他生病，元少都非常担心，什么事都不想做。
sentences.traditional: 每次他生病，元少都非常擔心，什麼事都不想做。
sentences.pinyin: měi cì tā shēng bìng yuán shào dōu fēi cháng dān xīn shén me shì dōu bù xiǎng zuò
sentences.english: Every time he was sick, Yuan Shao was very worried and didn’t want to do anything.

sentences.simplified: 现在听说小儿子又生病了，
sentences.traditional: 現在聽說小兒子又生病了，
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài tīng shuō xiǎo ér zi yòu shēng bìng le
sentences.english: Now when he heard that his youngest son was sick again, ..

sentences.simplified: 元少马上把信放在桌子上，看小儿子去了。
sentences.traditional: 元少馬上把信放在桌子上，看小兒子去了。
sentences.pinyin: yuán shào mǎ shàng bǎ xìn fàng zài zhuō zi shang kàn xiǎo ér zi qù le
sentences.english: .. Yuan Shao immediately put the letter on the table and went to see his youngest son.

sentences.simplified: 几天以后，元少的助手们听说了徐州的事，对他说：

sentences.english: A few days later, Yuan Shao’s assistants heard about Xuzhou and said to him, ..

sentences.simplified: “大人，我们要快去帮刘备，也可以现在打官渡。
sentences.traditional: “大人，我們要快去幫劉備，也可以現在打官渡。
sentences.pinyin: dà ren wǒ men yào kuài qù bāng liú bèi yě kě yǐ xiàn zài dǎ guān dù
sentences.english: .. “Lord, we must go quickly to help Liu Bei, or we can fight Guandu now.

sentences.simplified: 如果打败了曹操，半个国家就都是我们的了。”
sentences.traditional: 如果打敗了曹操，半個國家就都是我們的了。”
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ dǎ bài le cáo cāo bàn ge guó jiā jiù dōu shì wǒ men de le
sentences.english: If Cao Cao is defeated, half of the country will be ours.”

sentences.simplified: 但是这个时候的元少累极了，他现在什么都不想想。
sentences.traditional: 但是這個時候的元少累極了，他現在什麼都不想想。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì zhè ge shí hou de yuán shào lèi jí le tā xiàn zài shén me dōu bù xiǎng xiǎng
sentences.english: But this time, Yuan Shao was extremely tired, and he didn’t want to think about anything right now.

sentences.simplified: 他说：“我孩子的病还没好。现在我不想听这些事，再等等吧！”
sentences.traditional: 他說：“我孩子的病還沒好。現在我不想聽這些事，再等等吧！”
sentences.pinyin: tā shuō wǒ hái zi de bìng hái méi hǎo xiàn zài wǒ bù xiǎng tīng zhè xiē shì zài děng děng ba
sentences.english: He said, “My child is still sick. I don’t want to hear about this now. Wait for a while!”

sentence_translations: He’s Arrived
The next day, Cao Cao took his troops and headed for Xuzhou.
In the city of Xuzhou a few months previously, ..
.. Liu Bei had heard about Yuan Shao and Cao Cao at Guandu and knew things would turn bad.
Yuan Shao has many men, and Cao Cao has few men, so he should fight Cao Cao soon; the sooner, the better.
“Waiting” is not an option. “Waiting” will only make opportunities disappear and make good things become bad things.
Liu Bei knew that Cao Cao would still come to fight Xuzhou. He didn’t know where Cao Cao would come from, ..
.. so he had Zhang Fei and Guan Yu take some men to two small cities outside Xuzhou to watch.
That way, if Cao Cao came from those two small cities, they would know quickly.
Liu Bei also waited from August to December. It was a long time, and sometimes he would forget who he was waiting for.
Suddenly, this was the day. Cao Cao had arrived! He arrived with 200,000 troops!
So many troops suddenly came. Guan Yu and Zhang Fei didn’t know anything. Cao Cao had come too quickly!
Liu Bei had no choice but to immediately write to Yuan Shao and ask Yuan Shao to come and help him.
Yuan Shao had many troops. If Yuan Shao came immediately, Cao Cao would not dare to fight Xuzhou.
Yuan Shao was also surprised when he saw the letter. He didn’t know when Cao Cao had left Guandu.
He thought this was a good opportunity.
If I fight Guandu now, Cao Cao will not be able to return, and I can quickly take Guandu.
He was about to have a meeting with his assistants when a servant came in.
The servant said anxiously, “Lord Yuan. Something bad has happened. Your youngest son is sick again.”
Yuan Shao’s youngest son was his favorite child. The child was in poor health, and he got sick easily.
Every time he was sick, Yuan Shao was very worried and didn’t want to do anything.
Now when he heard that his youngest son was sick again, ..
.. Yuan Shao immediately put the letter on the table and went to see his youngest son.
A few days later, Yuan Shao’s assistants heard about Xuzhou and said to him, ..
.. “Lord, we must go quickly to help Liu Bei, or we can fight Guandu now.
If Cao Cao is defeated, half of the country will be ours.”
But this time, Yuan Shao was extremely tired, and he didn’t want to think about anything right now.
He said, “My child is still sick. I don’t want to hear about this now. Wait for a while!”
